doctrine: The receipt spine is public infrastructure; the axes, predicates and frozen benchmarks stay closed. Anyone can verify a receipt without paying or trusting CSOAI. Revenue still comes from relying parties, insurers and licensing — never from the verification itself. Measurement, not certification. Verification free forever.
note: The three open-source packages that make signed measurement reproducible outside the estate: the signing spine, the Art 14 oversight harness, and the CoSnitch-anchored memory-poisoning axis. All MIT, all E2E-verified, all with an honest-UNSIGNED path when no key is configured.

packages.name: inspect-signed-receipt
packages.what: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained measurement receipts for Inspect (inspect_ai) eval logs — the signing spine.
packages.why: Inspect is the standard eval framework across UK AISI, US CAISI, EU AI Office, METR, Apollo, Epoch — and had no cryptographic integrity. This fills the gap without forking.
packages.verified: real Inspect eval -> canonical EvalLog (RFC 8785) -> Ed25519 -> offline verify OK; tamper detected

packages.name: oversight-measurement
packages.what: Deterministic oversight/override measurement for AI warning systems — EU AI Act Article 14-aligned predicates.
packages.why: Measures whether humans actually acted on AI warnings (output-acceptance rate, automation-bias flag, override log quality). No dedicated open-source harness existed; a live vendor product confirms market pull.
packages.verified: real Inspect eval accuracy 1.000 + signed receipt verified offline

packages.name: memory-poisoning-axis
packages.what: Deterministic memory-poisoning / prompt-injection measurement — anchored to CVE-2026-24301 'CoSnitch' (Copilot Personal, CVSS 8.8, patched 18 Aug 2026).
packages.why: CoSnitch's persistent-memory stage 'survives password changes, session revocation and device re-enrollment' — measured with poisoned/survived/exfil predicates, no LLM judge.
packages.verified: real Inspect eval accuracy 1.000 + signed receipt verified offline
